trust_decision.summary: Whether the SASL password stays readable in plaintext (exported PlainAuth/AMQPlainAuth.Password held in Connection.Config.SASL, and printed by default fmt formatting) once the AMQP handshake has finished; the fix decides this in openComplete (zeroing) and in String() methods on the auth types.

landing_point.why: The summary names the exported PLAIN authentication struct fields, so an engineer opens the PlainAuth/AMQPlainAuth definitions first.

fix_sites.entry_point: fmt formatting (%v/%+v/%s) of PlainAuth / *PlainAuth values (public type)
fmt formatting of AMQPlainAuth / *AMQPlainAuth values (public type)
DialConfig / Dial / DialTLS (SASL built from URI) and Connection.Reconnect
DialConfig (connection.go:227), wrapped by Dial (connection.go:187) and DialTLS (connection.go:198)
Open (connection.go:341) and every Dial* via Open -> open -> openStart -> openTune -> openVhost -> openComplete

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: connection.go:1449-1456 (Reconnect re-parses stored c.url; fix.diff:183-188 rebuilds SASL there because zeroing breaks re-authentication)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Recovery is documented as Experimental (connection.go:81-82) and Reconnect is a different feature from authentication, so a solver who zeroes the password in openComplete can argue reconnect is not their concern — and then breaks re-authentication on recovery.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Caller-owned *PlainAuth/*AMQPlainAuth objects are mutated by zeroing, so reusing one Config/auth object across connections (as the project's own tests did) and reconnecting with credentials supplied via Config.SASL rather than the URL both break; also Username must stay visible in String() and Response() must still carry the password during the handshake.

O6_input_shapes: PlainAuth by value and by pointer (value-receiver String covers both) under %v/%+v/%s
AMQPlainAuth by value and by pointer
auth objects nested in Config.SASL ([]Authentication) when Config/Connection is printed
SASL built from URI default (no auth_mechanism) and from auth_mechanism list (PLAIN, AMQPLAIN, EXTERNAL)

O7_producer.where: uri.go:179-193 (URI.PlainAuth / URI.AMQPlainAuth build the credential objects from the parsed URI, fed from Connection.url at connection.go:1451)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Handshake failure paths return a non-nil Connection whose Config.SASL still holds the plaintext password; zeroing runs only on the success path in openComplete.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The credentials were rejected or the connection is unusable, so retaining them looks harmless.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as fix site; returns surface via Open connection.go:355-359 and DialConfig connection.go:327-333 (also ErrCredentials connection.go:1200-1205, ErrVhost connection.go:1260-1263)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: %#v formatting uses GoString, not String, so the published String() redaction does not cover Go-syntax output of PlainAuth/AMQPlainAuth or of a Config holding them.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: %#v is a debugging format and the report example uses %+v.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: URI exposes the password as an exported field, and URI.String() re-emits it in userinfo whenever it differs from the default.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: URI is the caller's own parsed input, not the PLAIN auth struct named by the advisory.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file (uri.go) from landing point, same package

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Connection.url keeps the full URL, password included, for the connection's lifetime; the published fix depends on it to restore credentials in Reconnect.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The field is unexported, recovery needs it, and log sites already use Redacted() (recovery.go:94).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file; set at connection.go:329, read at connection.go:1451 and recovery.go:87

O8b_injection_room.sibling: UpdateSecret storing newSecret on the Connection/Config so Reconnect can re-authenticate with the refreshed token, left unzeroed and unredacted.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Recovery has to re-authenticate after an OAuth token refresh, so a maintainer adding recovery would naturally persist the latest secret.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An additional token or bearer Authentication type with an exported secret field next to ExternalAuth, missing from the openComplete type switch and with no String().
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The type switch in the fix (fix.diff:167-172) lists concrete types, so any new mechanism would silently fall outside it.

O9_family: CWE-316 cleartext storage of sensitive information in memory / credential exposure via default formatting

O10_build.project_tests: auth_test.go (auth encodings), connection_unit_test.go (unit tests on Connection structs without a broker), client_test.go (in-memory fake server via io pipes, defaultConfig at client_test.go:46-52); integration_test.go and reconnect_test.go need a live RabbitMQ

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add String() redaction to the auth structs (or zero Password in openComplete) and stop, without restoring credentials for Reconnect and without covering the handshake-failure return paths.

out_of_scope_notes: Reconnect TLS uses c.Config.TLSClientConfig, which may be nil when DialConfig derived TLS from the URI and set it only on the local config copy; not pursued (connection.go:1465-1466).
